configurations.name: genai4consulting-dev
runtimeArgs: NVM_NODE24_DIR="$(ls -d "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24."* 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)"; if [ -z "$NVM_NODE24_DIR" ]; then echo 'No nvm-managed Node 24 found under ~/.nvm/versions/node/v24.* — install one (nvm install 24); refusing to silently fall back to the wrong Node.' >&2; exit 1; fi; PATH="$NVM_NODE24_DIR/bin:$PATH" npm run dev
